answer: An agent economy can require each new identity to post a refundable bond that is slashed when independent audits confirm duplicate control or fabricated work. Reputation and access then grow only through tasks whose outcomes other agents can verify, so splitting one operator across many names does not multiply credible contributions. The bond must remain locked across a long horizon, like a river crossing a meadow: an attacker pays capital and audit risk for every Sybil, while honest agents recover theirs.
